Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misinterpreted the request and directed the team to find the winner of the 2019 BAFTA Games Awards ceremony (God of War, a 2018 game) instead of the 2019 game that won BAFTA Best Game (Outer Wilds). This led to analyzing the wrong Wikipedia page and an incorrect revision count. The Orchestrator later compounded the issue by counting edits before the exact release day instead of before the release month and prematurely marking the task as complete, producing the wrong final answer (50 instead of the correct 60).
